name: NavMeshDebugLaunchMod
description: Launch overlay that boots the baked 4x4 open-world navmesh debug map (navmesh_debug_openworld) for the runtime navmesh overlay acceptance. Declares the NavMeshDebug_ToggleOverlay input action (N), owns the showcase navmesh profile override, and warms resident tiles on enable. Map, terrain, and tiles live in LudotsCoreMod assets.
author: Ludots Team
